# Add ASCII/UTF-8 encoding to ByteBuf and BytesBlob

## Pull Request by @tomusdrw

## Summary

- Add `ByteBuf.strAscii()` and `ByteBuf.strUtf8()` (renamed from `.str()`) for explicit encoding choice
- Add `ByteBuf.wrap(data)` to write directly into an existing `Uint8Array` without copying
- Add `BytesBlob.encodeAscii()` and `BytesBlob.encodeUtf8()` static constructors
- Replace `String.UTF8.encode` usage in `panic.ts`, test utilities, and examples with the lightweight ASCII variants — saves ~520 B WASM / ~1.15 KB PVM for services that don't otherwise need full UTF-8 machinery

## Test plan

- [x] All 151 existing tests pass (110 SDK + 2 all-ecalli + 3 authorizer + 31 ecalli-test + 5 fibonacci)
- [x] Pre-push hooks pass (QA, build, test)
- [ ] Verify WASM/PVM size reduction on fibonacci and authorizer examples

## Walkthrough

This PR updates documentation and refactors byte/string and encoder APIs across the SDK, examples, and tests. Changes include ASCII/UTF‑8-specific APIs (rename `ByteBuf.str` → `ByteBuf.strAscii`, add `ByteBuf.strUtf8`), new `ByteBuf.wrap`, new `BytesBlob` helpers (`encodeAscii`, `encodeUtf8`, `zero`, `ptr`, `subarray`) and `Bytes32.zero`/`.ptr()`/`.length`, encoder finalization changes (`finishRaw()` / `finish()` swap), Response/Context use of `finishRaw()`, pervasive migration of call sites/tests/examples to `ByteBuf`/`BytesBlob` pointer/length semantics, and the addition of `examples/all-ecalli/assembly/test-data.ts`. Documentation files and coding guidelines were updated to prefer ASCII helpers where appropriate.
